Interface InteractBlockEvent.Secondary

All Superinterfaces:
Event, InteractBlockEvent, InteractEvent
All Known Subinterfaces:
InteractBlockEvent.Secondary.Post, InteractBlockEvent.Secondary.Pre
Enclosing interface:
InteractBlockEvent
public static interface InteractBlockEvent.Secondary extends InteractBlockEvent
An event where the targeted block is being interacted with the client's "secondary" button.

This is usually right-click.

    • useItemResult

      Tristate useItemResult()
      Gets whether the ArmorEquipable.itemInHand(Supplier) should be used.
      • FALSE: The ItemStack will never be used.
      • UNDEFINED: The ItemStack will be used if the block fails.
      • TRUE: The ItemStack will always be used.

      Note: These results may differ depending on implementation.

      Returns:
      Whether the ArmorEquipable.itemInHand(Supplier) should be used

    • useBlockResult

      Tristate useBlockResult()
      Gets whether the interacted BlockSnapshot should be used.
      • FALSE: BlockSnapshot will never be used.
      • UNDEFINED: BlockSnapshot will be used as normal.
      • TRUE: BlockSnapshot will always be used.

      Note: These results may differ depending on implementation.

      Returns:
      Whether the interacted BlockSnapshot should be used
